persons.name: Jasakīrti
persons.evidence: dānapatiśrīkāṣṭhamaṇḍapamahānagare rañjanatvalake(?) , śrīkīrttipuṇyamahāvihāre , śrīvajradhātumahāvihārāvasthita , yaṃ ........ (94v5) nānāratnaparikṣaka dharmātmā..............śākyabhikṣuśrījasakīrttiju

purpose: yad ata(!) puṇyaṃ tad bhavatv ācāryopā°
notes: Jasakīrti is likely the vernacular Newari form of Jayakīrtika, the primary donor. The king's name before '...nasya vijayarāje' is lost in the lacuna. Additional names follow after fol. 94v5 but are omitted in the catalogue quote.
